Backend: 25/25 pytest cases passed (login flows, public endpoints, 401 on missing/invalid token, Petugas can GET all data endpoints, Petugas gets 403 with correct Indonesian message on every mutating endpoint tested, Koordinator full mapping CRUD flow succeeds). UI: unauthenticated navigation to / and /master-reagen both show login-card

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py uses os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] on every request via _secret(); if the env var is ever missing the app will 500 rather than fail-fast at startup. Consider loading & caching at module import (fail-fast).

seed_accounts() stores plaintext passwords in the ACCOUNTS list constant in source — acceptable given the fixed-2-account product requirement, but note in README that changing these requires a code edit + restart.
server.py has grown further with auth deps on every route; consider a small dependency alias (e.g. AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user)) to reduce visual noise. Non-blocking.
